ground_floor.name: Main Entrance
ground_floor.description: Main entrance to Sahad Hospital - starting point for all navigation
ground_floor.directions: This is your starting point

ground_floor.name: Ophthalmology Department
ground_floor.description: Eye care and vision services department
ground_floor.directions: First door on your left immediately after entering the main entrance

ground_floor.name: Front Desk
ground_floor.description: Main information and patient registration point in the main hall
ground_floor.directions: From main entrance, continue straight or turn right to enter main hall. Front desk is on the left side

ground_floor.name: Pharmacy
ground_floor.description: Hospital pharmacy for prescription medications and over-the-counter drugs
ground_floor.directions: From main entrance, enter main hall (straight or turn right). Pharmacy is on the right side of the main hall

ground_floor.name: Cashier
ground_floor.description: Payment and billing services for hospital charges
ground_floor.directions: From main entrance, enter main hall. Cashier is on the right side next to the Pharmacy

ground_floor.name: Consulting Room
ground_floor.description: General consultation rooms for patient appointments
ground_floor.directions: From main entrance, enter main hall. Located on the left side between Front Desk and Nursing Station

ground_floor.name: Nursing Station
ground_floor.description: Central nursing station for patient care coordination
ground_floor.directions: From main entrance, enter main hall. Located on the left side after the Consulting Room

ground_floor.name: Washroom
ground_floor.description: Public washroom facilities in the main hall
ground_floor.directions: From main entrance, enter main hall. Located on the left side after the Nursing Station

ground_floor.name: VIP Lounge
ground_floor.description: VIP waiting and consultation area for premium patients
ground_floor.directions: From Front Desk, take the straight passage between Front Desk and Consulting Room to the second hall. VIP Lounge is on the left side

ground_floor.name: HOD - Family Medicine
ground_floor.description: Head of Department office for Family Medicine
ground_floor.directions: From Front Desk, take straight passage to second hall. Located on left side after VIP Lounge

ground_floor.name: Ultrasound Room
ground_floor.description: Ultrasound imaging services for diagnostic procedures
ground_floor.directions: From Front Desk, take straight passage to second hall. Located on left side after Family Medicine office

ground_floor.name: Staff Toilets
ground_floor.description: Restroom facilities designated for hospital staff
ground_floor.directions: From Front Desk, take straight passage to second hall. Located on left side after Ultrasound Room

ground_floor.name: Radiology Department
ground_floor.description: Medical imaging services including X-rays and diagnostic radiology
ground_floor.directions: From Front Desk, take straight passage to second hall. Radiology is on the right side

ground_floor.name: Laboratory Unit
ground_floor.description: Main laboratory unit with multiple specialized sections
ground_floor.directions: From Front Desk, take straight passage to second hall, then continue straight ahead to reach the Laboratory Unit

ground_floor.name: Hematology
ground_floor.description: Hematology section within the laboratory for blood analysis
ground_floor.directions: Inside the Laboratory Unit, Hematology is located on the left side

ground_floor.name: Microbiology
ground_floor.description: Microbiology section within the laboratory for infection and culture testing
ground_floor.directions: Inside the Laboratory Unit, Microbiology is located on the left side next to Hematology

ground_floor.name: Chemical Pathology
ground_floor.description: Chemical Pathology section within the laboratory for biochemical analysis
ground_floor.directions: Inside the Laboratory Unit, Chemical Pathology is located on the left side after Microbiology

ground_floor.name: Laboratory Reception
ground_floor.description: Reception area within the Laboratory Unit for patient check-in and specimen handling
ground_floor.directions: Inside the Laboratory Unit, the Reception is located directly ahead as you enter

ground_floor.name: Phlebotomy Unit
ground_floor.description: Blood collection and specimen gathering unit within the laboratory
ground_floor.directions: Inside the Laboratory Unit, pass through the Reception to reach the Phlebotomy Unit

ground_floor.name: Ground Floor Section Reception
ground_floor.description: Reception area in the Ground Floor Section hall
ground_floor.directions: From main hall, walk past the Pharmacy section, take the only exit leading to Ground Floor Section. Reception is in this hall

ground_floor.name: Canteen
ground_floor.description: Hospital canteen providing meals and refreshments for patients, visitors, and staff
ground_floor.directions: From main hall, walk past Pharmacy, take exit to Ground Floor Section. Canteen is in the hall next to Reception

ground_floor.name: Gynecology Department
ground_floor.description: Gynecology department for women's health services
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section hall, Gynecology is located opposite the Reception and Canteen

ground_floor.name: Emergency Department
ground_floor.description: 24-hour emergency medical services for urgent and critical care
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section, take the exit opposite Reception/Canteen (near Gynecology) leading to Emergency

ground_floor.name: ANC (Antenatal Care)
ground_floor.description: Antenatal care services for expectant mothers and pregnancy monitoring
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section, take the exit near Gynecology that leads to Emergency, ANC, and Labor Ward

ground_floor.name: Labor Ward
ground_floor.description: Labor and delivery ward for childbirth services
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section, take the exit near Gynecology that leads to Emergency, ANC, and Labor Ward

ground_floor.name: Staircase to Second Floor (Near Ground Floor Reception)
ground_floor.description: Staircase leading to the second floor of the hospital
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section hall, the staircase is on your first left as you enter

ground_floor.name: Staircase to Second Floor (Main)
ground_floor.description: Main staircase leading to the second floor
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section hall, continue straight ahead - the staircase is on the right

ground_floor.name: Theater
ground_floor.description: Surgical theater for medical operations and procedures
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section hall, take the corridor that leads to Theater and MRI Unit

ground_floor.name: MRI Unit
ground_floor.description: MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) unit for detailed medical imaging
ground_floor.directions: From Ground Floor Section hall, take the corridor that leads to Theater and MRI Unit
